college_identity.verified_name: National Institute of Technology, Andhra Pradesh (NIT ANP / NITAP)
college_identity.identity_notes: The 31st and newest NIT, established September 2015-16. Mentored by NIT Warangal per Collegedunia. Previously operated from a temporary campus at Vasavi before shifting to its current permanent campus (reported acreage varies across sources: ~172.6 acres, ~173 acres, ~176 acres, and ~350 acres all appeared in different sources — this range is preserved rather than resolved to a single figure) in Tadepalligudem, West Godavari district. No conflicting separate institutions of similar name identified; an unrelated 'Nimra Medical College' ragging-question result was correctly excluded as irrelevant during search.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'Placement of our college is in growing stage. Placement of core departments is good as compared to it[s] branch. Average package of this college is 7 LPA. As this is the newest NIT, then also it has good placement and alumni connections.'
'In NIT AP the college infrastructure is excellent, well advanced library and research labs and best curriculum.'
'Good hostel facilities and good atmosphere and better living conditions.'

'From 7th semester the students are eligible for campus placements. The companies visited NIT AP are Google, Microsoft, and Amazon etc. As per the placement statistics of 2023, the highest package is 44 LPA and average package is 8.13 LPA. The placement percentage [is] 85%.'
'The faculty in the 1st year is not that [much] understanding and behaviour is not that good.'
'No internships are provided on campus. 98% students don't do any internships up to 6th semester.'
'I hate [the] college curriculum, there will be 2 more subjects you need to study in [the final year] even if you are in an internship or a job.'
'I liked the hostel facilities in the college, the rooms are very clean. We have current [electricity] availability almost 24/7. There will be showers in bathroom.'
'The one more thing I liked in the college is food. The food taste is good but in mornings it will be not as good as in [the] afternoon. The food will be supplied [in a] limited [amount].'
'The bathrooms are the only things I have disliked in the hostel because there will be no supply of hot water for 1st year. We need to bath with cold water in winter also.'
'I disliked the sports and gym facilities in this college. There are more people in the college but there are less courts in every sport. We need to wait [a] lot to play. The gym is also too small.'

'I am not comfortable here with the laboratories because there is no better equipment to do the project and there is no freedom for their own access to use those equipment without [the] help of faculty.'
'I like the atmosphere and campus, it's beautiful, walkable distance from bus stand and all shops are available in Tadepalligudem.'
'Hostel maintenance is very good, rooms are spacious.'
'There are companies coming to the college, most of the CSE students get placed and almost ECE also the same situation.'
'Summers here affect us pretty hard, as this college is located on the coast. The humidity here is pretty high; however there are AC libraries where you can sustain [yourself] in summer.'
'The mess is average. One cannot expect the mess quality to be like how it was at home, but it's okay-okay and sometimes the curries are too spicy.'
'Sometimes the power cuts can be exhausting, and these are rare.'

review_items.review_title: Real and Raw Review of NIT Andhra Pradesh

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'In my Civil Engineering department, the placement percentage was above 60 percent. However, the average placement package and the highest were way too low, the latter being 6.5 lakhs per annum.'

'75% of students get placed in this course. The highest package this year is 35 LPA and the lowest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 8.5 LPA. Some recruiting companies like TCS, Amazon, Ola, etc., visit the college for placements. Many students got internships in various companies like Microsoft, ISRO, etc.'

'There are large classrooms which are capable of fitting 90-100 students at a time. Classrooms are fitted with smart TVs, blackboards, and whiteboards. Hostels are very neat and new. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel with good connectivity.'
'The food is hygienic, healthy, and tasty. A 24x7 medical facility is available.'
